mode.title: What to do when sensitive data is found
mode.description: log = record only (the default, for the first 14 days); warn = ask first; justify = ask for a reason first; redact = paste with the sensitive parts hidden (other actions warn); approve = held until IT approves; block = refuse.

watchedSites.title: Sites to watch
watchedSites.description: Host names (subdomains included). Empty means every site.

ignoreKinds.title: Kinds of data to record but never act on
